svg.title: Bottle inspection pipeline — full architecture
svg.desc: Eight-stage pipeline from raw label ingestion through ROI extraction, augmentation, model architecture, two-phase training, hyperparameter tuning, threshold calibration, to final evaluation.

g.text: CSV row (label, area_px) → binary 0/1 via three-tier resolver
Albumentations pipeline · val/test: resize + normalise only
Backbone frozen → head warmup → unfreeze → cosine fine-tune
TPE sampler · 50 trials · safety gate: recall_faulty ≥ 0.99
Calibrate on val set · apply to test · never touch test during training
F1 · precision · recall · AUC-ROC · PR-AUC · confusion matrix · predictions CSV
